chain.label: Approach conducted at night with no advance warning of any control anomaly
chain.trigger: the accident occurred about 2341 during hours of darkness

chain.label: Pilot did not perceive that flight spoilers remained extended after being deployed during the turn to final
chain.trigger: the pilot of Night Air 4 extended spoilers during the turn to the final approach and inadvertently did not retract them until over the approach lights

chain.label: Asymmetric spoiler retraction: left spoiler retracted, right spoiler did not
chain.trigger: The cause of the uncommanded roll was an asymmetric retraction of the flight spoilers wherein the left spoiler retracted and the right spoiler did not

caused_by.evidence: as the airplane passed over the approach lights, the pilot realized that the spoilers were extended and retracted them

chain.label: Uncommanded roll to the right
chain.trigger: the cause of the accident was an uncommanded roll to the right which caused the airplane to roll about 90 degrees and descend into the ground

caused_by.evidence: since the right spoiler did not retract the airplane started a slow roll to the right

chain.label: Pilot applied insufficient aileron and rudder input to arrest the developing roll
chain.trigger: While the pilot added power, he apparently did not use enough aileron and rudder control input to arrest the roll

caused_by.evidence: the pilot apparently did not detect the roll before the roll rate developed to the extent that the airplane could not be controlled

if an asymmetrical spoiler condition were to occur at night on final approach, airplane roll rates might develop to a degree that delayed recovery inputs by an unwary pilot would not be sufficient to stop the roll

chain.label: Airplane rolled to about 90 degrees, nose dropped, and struck the ground
chain.trigger: the airplane's nose dropped below the horizon and the airplane descended into the ground in a nose low attitude

caused_by.evidence: the airplane rolled inverted and crashed

chain.label: Postimpact explosion and fire; both pilots and the passenger were killed
chain.trigger: the witnesses stated that they saw an explosion which was followed by intense ground fire...both pilots and the one passenger on board were killed

caused_by.evidence: the airplane was destroyed by impact and postimpact fire
